build.title: Fix: stale running counts per Claude account not cleared

said.text: Seen Nov 9: claude_accounts shows Hulu 1/3, Moses X 4/3, account-1 4/3 running while the VPS has 0 tmux axf-* sessions and 0 claude -p processes. Rule (Brett): every time the console loads, and on the watchdog tick, the orchestrator checks for stale runs and releases any slot or running entry with no live process (agent-slots, claude-workers.mjs counts, orchestrator.json statuses). Find why the existing check didn't run or didn't clear these; fix; add a test with fake stale entries; log each release.

steps.text: Find why stale running counts survive (console-load check, slot-watchdog, claude-workers counts); fix release of slots with no live process on console load and watchdog tick; test; log releases
